title: Naturality of the tensorator given by component models and scalar units
statement: Let I:A→B be a functor, R and T bifunctors on A and B, and U:S≅id_A a natural isomorphism. Suppose m_(M,N):T(IM,IN)≅I(R(SM,SN)) is natural in both variables. Then the inverse of the composite m_(M,N) ≫ I(R(U_M,U_N)) is a natural transformation R;I→(I×I);T. The displayed Lean equation states its naturality on an arbitrary arrow of A×A.

source.place: Compatibility: naturality of the finite model and coefficient-unit comparisons.

proof.text: Assemble m and its assumed naturality into a natural isomorphism using NatIso.ofComponents. Compose with the right whiskering of NatIso.prod U U and invert. Its naturality equation at f evaluates to the displayed component formula.

proof_origin.place: Compatibility; generic naturality calculation for the explicit inclusion tensorator.

mathlib_searches.verdict: NatIso.ofComponents constructs the model isomorphism; naturality of its corrected inverse gives the result.
Generic component and whiskering formulas are available; the combined equation is a short categorical lemma.

from.place: Present the same canonical tensorator directly by its components, with a generic proof of naturality.

lean.statement:
theorem tensoratorFromModel_naturality
    {A B : Type*} [Category* A] [Category* B]
    (I : A ⥤ B) (R : A × A ⥤ A) (T : B × B ⥤ B)
    {S : A ⥤ A} (U : S ≅ 𝟭 A)
    (m : ∀ K : A × A, T.obj (I.obj K.1, I.obj K.2) ≅
      I.obj (R.obj (S.obj K.1, S.obj K.2)))
    (hm : ∀ {K L : A × A} (f : K ⟶ L),
      T.map (Prod.mkHom (I.map f.1) (I.map f.2)) ≫ (m L).hom =
        (m K).hom ≫ I.map (R.map (Prod.mkHom (S.map f.1) (S.map f.2))))
    {K L : A × A} (f : K ⟶ L) :
    (R ⋙ I).map f ≫
        (m L ≪≫ I.mapIso (R.mapIso (Iso.prod (U.app L.1) (U.app L.2)))).inv =
      (m K ≪≫ I.mapIso (R.mapIso (Iso.prod (U.app K.1) (U.app K.2)))).inv ≫
        (I.prod I ⋙ T).map f
